source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: The p.Arg1809Cys substitution in neurofibromin is associated with a distinctive NF1 phenotype without neurofibromas.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 10 Pinna 2015 PMID 25370043. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.Overlaps the codon 1809 claim from the Gutmann 2017 Primer (different primary paper: Rojnueangnit 2015); possible supporting evidence for the same claim.
